sources.note: Skånetrafiken's terminal map of Lund C, updated December 2025 (PDF 81216_lundc_terminalkarta_a3, supplied by the owner): track numbers, which platforms have lifts and stairs at Skyttelbron, Mittelbron and Rydes undergång, and ticket machines. Placed by fitting its lift symbols to OpenStreetMap's lifts (median 2 m off); used to check the map, not copied. Not ODbL: ask Skånetrafiken before publishing beyond the demo; see data/stations/README.md.

Jernhusen's station pages: which cafés, shops and services are at the station, Espresso House's hours, card-paid toilets, code lockers, a cash machine in the station building; Rydes undergång open 05.00–00.00, the north footbridge always open. Facts checked by hand, nothing copied in bulk.
Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000120).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (extract of 2026-10-20) with 15 hand connections (north footbridge deck, platform 1's lift and ground-level links, platform 6's lift at Västra station), checked against Skånetrafiken's terminal map (December 2025). Amenities checked against Jernhusen (2026-10-22): Espresso House hours updated; 4 ticket machines and the cash machine added from OSM.
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 55 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000120).
